Why does a joint need a pair of muscles to move both ways?

Dog: backbone inside. Earthworm: no backbone.

In this model, contract means get shorter and pull. A muscle does not push a bone.

Carbohydrate gives energy. Protein helps growth and repair. Calcium helps build strong bones. Foods have a mix of nutrients.
